correctness.rationale: Each of the fourteen arc choices is tested exhaustively under the iff directed path-forest criterion; 290 faces result. An explicit 140-pair acyclic matching is verified over 876 oriented cover edges with a topological order, yielding critical vector (1,0,3,4,2). Every signed cancellation has integral unit pivot, and all final Morse differentials vanish; hence integral homology is free with ranks 3,4,2 in degrees 2,3,4. The signed cycle lift/projection computes all V4 action matrices, verifies group relations and characters. Separate mod-two boundary ranks and fixed-face Lefschetz calculations agree. No higher-homotopy assertion is made.

value.rationale: The three-rung ladder is the first canonical planar two-square grid beyond a bidirected polygon, making the graph intrinsic rather than an arbitrary slice. Its directed-path-forest complex exhibits torsion-free homology in three consecutive dimensions and a nontrivial complete rational four-symmetry character, neither implied by the identified path/polygon or oriented-grid results. The result is a self-contained exact benchmark with explicit finite integral certificates. No all-ladder claim or unsupported downstream applications are asserted.
